qualification.method: Complete 120-case standard run and complete 120-case serial bridge run on the final native build and eight-patch driver. Initial parallel bridge attempt is preserved separately and superseded; it had a driver startup failure before TCP establishment. An ephemeral-port allocation race is suspected but the underlying exception was not logged, so the cause is unconfirmed.
